headline: HP Inc. launches strategic partnership with OpenAI to deploy AI across various sectors.

items.title: HP Inc. launches Frontier strategic partnership with OpenAI
items.summary: HP Inc. has announced an expansion of its strategic partnership with OpenAI, known as Frontier, aimed at deploying AI technologies across customer experiences, software development, and enterprise operations. This collaboration is expected to enhance HP's AI capabilities, leveraging OpenAI's advanced models to improve efficiency and innovation in these areas.
items.why_it_matters: This partnership could lead to advanced AI integration in enterprise solutions, offering new tools and capabilities for developers.

items.title: Herdr: Agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal
items.summary: Herdr is a newly released agent multiplexer designed to operate within a terminal environment. This tool allows developers to manage multiple agents simultaneously, facilitating smoother integration and operation of agent-based applications directly from the terminal.
